questions.question: Which description fits the **ConceptMap** resource?
options: A statement of relationships from one set of concepts to one or more other concepts - either concepts in code systems, or data element/data element concepts, or classes in class models.
A curated namespace that issues unique symbols within that namespace for the identification of concepts, people, devices, etc.
This resource documents a set of capabilities (behaviors) of a FHIR Terminology Server that may be used as a statement of actual server functionality or a statement of required or desired server…
This resource instance specifies a set of codes drawn from one or more code systems, intended for use in a particular context.
questions.explanation: **ConceptMap**: A statement of relationships from one set of concepts to one or more other concepts - either concepts in code systems, or data element/data element concepts, or classes in class models. The other descriptions belong to **NamingSystem**, **TerminologyCapabilities**, **ValueSet**.

questions.question: Which resource would you use? Map a hospital’s local lab codes to LOINC.
You know **ConceptMap**. Which resource should you use instead when you need “transforms whole structures, not just codes”?
questions.explanation: **StructureMap**: transforms whole structures, not just codes. **ConceptMap** is for something else: A statement of relationships from one set of concepts to one or more other concepts - either concepts in code systems, or data element/data element concepts, or classes in class models.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **ConceptMap** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of ConceptMap are `status` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **ConceptMap** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of ConceptMap: `status`. `status`: draft | active | retired | unknown. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
